info.title: AWS Warehouse Intake API
info.description: Warehouse browser and API with password sessions, product registration, barcode lookup, actor attribution and asynchronous receiving. Browser sessions use HttpOnly cookies plus same-origin/CSRF validation for mutations. Optional configured RS256 JWTs remain available for machine integrations. Warehouse access is explicit, including for administrators. A 202 confirms durable acceptance; poll until APPLIED or REJECTED. Preserve Idempotency-Key and externalReference across retries.

put.description: Browser cookie requests require X-CSRF-Token and an Origin equal to PUBLIC_ORIGIN. Bearer-token integrations do not use CSRF cookies. SKU and barcode share one unique namespace within the organization. Barcode replacement is atomic; tracking mode is immutable. Ownership and creator audit fields are assigned by the server and rejected in request bodies.

post.summary: Sign in with organization, username and password
post.description: Username is trimmed and lowercased. Five attempts per account and thirty per IP are allowed within 15 minutes, including successful attempts. Credentials are verified against salted scrypt hashes. No public account signup.

username.description: Normalized to lowercase; letters, numbers, dot, underscore, at-sign, plus and hyphen.

Set-Cookie.description: Opaque eight-hour session. Production uses __Host-warehouse_session with Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Path=/.

browserSession.name: __Host-warehouse_session
browserSession.description: Production opaque HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookie. Issued by /auth/login; never copied into browser storage.

localBrowserSession.name: warehouse_session
localBrowserSession.description: Local development session cookie; production uses browserSession.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Required for mutations authenticated by a browser cookie; obtained from /auth/login or /auth/session.

recordedBy.description: Verified actor for the original acceptance, preserved on replay. Absent on historical records accepted before actor capture.

createdBy.description: Original verified actor. Absent for unattributed legacy records.

TrustedOrigin.name: Origin
TrustedOrigin.description: Must equal configured PUBLIC_ORIGIN exactly. Browsers set this header; cross-origin login/mutations are rejected.
